Topic: <details><summary>[Introduction to Wulver: Getting Started with HPC]()</summary>This virtual session will provide essential information about the Wulver cluster, how to get an account, and allocation details, accessing installed software.</details>

<details><summary>[Introduction to Wulver: Job Submission and Resource Requests]()</summary> This webinar will introduce researchers, scientists, and HPC users to the fundamentals of the SLURM (Simple Linux Utility for Resource Management) workload manager. This virtual session will provide the information on effectively utilizing HPC resources through SLURM. </details>

<details><summary>[Introduction to Wulver: Job Efficiency and Resource Utilization]()</summary> This webinar will show HPC users how to make the most of their Wulver allocation. This virtual session will cover monitoring CPU, GPU, and memory usage for running and completed jobs, interpreting job efficiency reports, and right-sizing resource requests to shorten queue wait times and avoid wasted core-hours. </details>

<details><summary>[COMSOL Multiphysics Workshop]()</summary> You are invited to join us for an opportunity to advance your skills in multiphysics simulation. At this workshop, you will see the capabilities and workflow of the COMSOL Multiphysics® software and learn through a guided hands-on exercise. </details>

<details><summary>[Managing Your Research Software Environment on Wulver: Modules, Conda, and Containers for Python and Beyond]()</summary> This webinar will show HPC users how to set up and manage the software their research needs on Wulver. This virtual session will cover finding and loading installed software with environment modules, creating Conda environments for Python packages, and running containers with Apptainer, along with tips for keeping environments reproducible and avoiding common package conflicts. </details>
